%s ist die Verwaltungsschnittstelle dies: %s is the management interface of this host. The relay needs an interface of its own for the player networks.
<b>%s Spiele</b> sind von Anfang an eing: %s games are switched on from the start, the usual LAN games. Switch on more under Games afterwards.
<b>Der Host ist nicht vollständig abgesc: The host is not fully shielded. The relay works all the same. The engine could not set up everything itself:
Abhilfe: Der Engine-Container braucht da: Remedy: the engine container needs the host network and the capabilities NET_ADMIN and NET_RAW (they are in compose.yaml). If that is not possible, prepare the host once by hand: sudo sh deploy/host/setup.sh <trunk>
Adresse des Relays: letzte Stelle: Address of the relay: last number
An welcher Netzwerkschnittstelle dieses: Which network interface of this server carries the player networks? Usually it is a trunk: one line to the switch on which every network arrives as a VLAN with its own number.
Auf den Relay-Schnittstellen ließ sich d: Routing could not be switched off on the relay interfaces.
Automatisch jeden Tag, die letzten %d bl: Automatically every day, the last %d are kept.
Bitte die Schnittstelle wählen, an der d: Please choose the interface that carries the networks as a trunk.
Bitte einen Namen für die LAN eingeben (: Please enter a name for the LAN party (60 characters at most).
Bitte mindestens zwei Netze eintragen. D: Please enter at least two networks. The relay connects networks with each other.
Das Konto ließ sich nicht anlegen. Bitte: The account could not be created. Please try again.
Das Passwort braucht mindestens %d Zeich: The password needs at least %d characters.
Das Passwort ist zu lang (höchstens 200: The password is too long (200 characters at most).
Das Relay leitet sofort weiter. Nur wenn: The relay forwards right away. Only if no other relay distributes the same games between these networks, otherwise packets arrive twice.
Das Relay zählt mit und zeigt, was es we: The relay counts and shows what it would forward, but sends nothing. A safe way to see whether all networks arrive.
Der Host leitet IPv4 weiter (ip_forward): The host forwards IPv4 (ip_forward) and the engine could not prevent it for the relay interfaces: the host can route between the networks.
Der Name braucht 2 bis 32 Zeichen: Buchs: The name needs 2 to 32 characters: letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore.
Der Rückweg für die Verwaltungsadresse l: The return route for the management address could not be set. From a player network the web UI may hang then.
Die Einrichtung ist gespeichert, aber da: The setup is saved, but applying it failed: %s
Die Engine antwortet nicht, deshalb wurd: The engine does not answer, so nothing was saved. Is the engine container running? (%s)
Die Host-Firewall für die Relay-Schnitts: The host firewall for the relay interfaces could not be set up. Services of the host such as SSH are reachable from the player networks; the web UI itself refuses such connections.
Die Schnittstelle %s gibt es auf diesem: There is no interface %s on this host.
Die Seite war veraltet. Bitte noch einma: The page was out of date. Please try again.
Die Stelle %d passt nicht in %s (höchste: The number %d does not fit into %s (%d at most).
Die Stelle der Relay-Adresse muss eine Z: The number of the relay address must be a number, e.g. 250.
Die automatische Sicherung ist aus (NSRE: The automatic backup is off (NSRELAY_BACKUP_DIR not set or NSRELAY_BACKUP_AUTO=0).
The two passwords are not the same.
Diese Seite ist offen, bis das erste Kon: This page is open until the first account exists. After that it is gone.
Diesen Namen gibt es schon. Nimm einen a: This name exists already. Take another one.
Dieses Relay ist neu. Leg zuerst das Adm: This relay is new. Create the admin account first, the network comes next.
Ein Name hier gilt statt der Auswahl obe: A name here is used instead of the choice above.
Eine Zeile pro Netz, mindestens zwei. Le: One row per network, at least two. Empty rows do not count. The group decides who sees whose games: tables, game servers and orga see each other, WiFi stays out for now.
Fertig eingerichtet: %d Netze, %d Spiele: Setup finished: %d networks, %d games. The relay observes now. Switch to “Active” under System.
Setup finished: %d networks, %d games. The relay forwards now.
Hat schon eine eigene Adresse. Sie bleib: Has an address of its own already. It stays, the networks are added as VLANs.
IPv6 ließ sich auf den Relay-Schnittstel: IPv6 could not be switched off on the relay interfaces.
Mindestens %d Zeichen. Ein langer Satz i: At least %d characters. A long sentence beats a short riddle.
With 250 the relay gets 10.10.1.250 in the network 10.10.1.0/24. The address must be free in every network, so outside the DHCP range.
Netze lieber einzeln anlegen: Rather add networks one by one
Sag dem Relay, wo die Netze der Spieler: Tell the relay where the player networks arrive. It gets an address in every network and distributes the game search between them. Everything here can be changed later under Network and System.
So wie sie auf dem Server heißt (ip link: As it is called on the server (ip link).
Verwaltung: Über diese Schnittstelle err: Management: you reach the server through this interface. The relay only uses it when it is listed in NSRELAY_ALLOWED_IFACES of the engine.
